formulas.ascii: Reduce binary queen or rook cardinalities over every feature, including zero-neighbor islands. The linear median averages the two middle cardinalities for even populations. Candidate or final CSR overflow invalidates the entire profile. This fixture has two edge-adjacent squares and one island: cardinalities [1,1,0], median 1.
